records.subject: You're in -- let's get Bright Works set up
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Your workspace for Bright Works is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Bright Works* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no milestone despite a held onboarding call [calendar:9f72a2f5] and three unanswered emails [email:e7c6c7ba], [email:b9317ddd], [email:e220a183]. Zero customer replies or tickets signals low engagement; 8 days left makes unaided activation possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: One next step for Bright Works in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

It was good to talk last week. Since then I haven't wanted to pile on, so this is my last nudge for a while: the first project is still the step that makes everything else click, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and you can invite a teammate from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

If it's easier to do together, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and set up your first real project with you.

Best,
Priya
